finite_execution_rule: Every chain launch must freeze an explicit finite maximum target level and finite resource budgets. An unbounded --until-trigger launch is invalid.
hard_nonclaims: No lattice or closed-algebra promotion from bounded closure metrics.
No O-level execution or OFormal graduation.
immutability_rules: A chain plan is immutable after start.
Runtime source, wheel, primitive, observer, selection rules, evidence boundary, trigger registry and protocol template are fixed for the whole chain.
Any source or semantic change starts a new chain from the last eligible parent.
No adaptive lane extension, observer change, metric addition or outcome-driven sampling is permitted inside a chain.
purpose: Automate a finite sequence of bounded L-level Scout transitions through the graduated unified runtime without weakening per-level packet sealing, provenance, evidence boundaries, or stop-on-interest discipline.
